title: Dreamer and Raven become unwilling champions
summary: Raven’s surprise return places him beside the man he tormented for years. The championship partnership forces Dreamer to coexist with an ally whose motives he cannot trust.

chapters.title: Raven returns and wins with Dreamer
chapters.show: The Last Show at the Madhouse
chapters.result: Raven and Dreamer defeat the Dudleys for the tag championships.
chapters.context: Raven’s unexpected help leaves Dreamer tied to his longtime enemy. This is the match date, before its TNN broadcast.

chapters.title: The Impact Players take their belts
chapters.result: Storm and Credible defeat Raven and Dreamer for the tag titles.
chapters.context: The uneasy champions lose to a more unified team, without resolving their own distrust.
